summary: Candidate is a SLURM job submission wrapper that orchestrates the same distributed training workflow already covered by peer candidates (Accelerate orchestration + DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 3). The candidate adds SLURM-specific syntax but does not introduce a distinct capability—it is a job scheduler integration layer for capabilities already represented. Merging into Accelerate and DeepSpeed skills avoids duplication and consolidates multi-node training guidance into the orchestration and memory-efficiency layers where it belongs.
